keep-reading.subject: Frankenstein
keep-reading.recap: Robert Walton writes to his sister from a ship pushing north towards the Pole. Trapped in the ice, the crew sees a huge figure crossing it on a dog sledge. The next morning they take aboard a second traveller, frozen and close to death, who has been chasing the first. As he recovers, the stranger agrees to tell Walton his story as a warning.
